apps.name: RagaMentor
apps.versionDescription: v1.5.40 — Two fixes. Returning to a song whose loop is playing now reliably lands zoomed into that loop, as if you had just selected it (the restore could be lost before). The loop note editor gains a keyboard bar with Cancel and Done, so a note can be finished or abandoned without hunting for a way to dismiss the keyboard; an unchanged note no longer rewrites itself.
apps.localizedDescription: RagaMentor native: LoopLab — slow down songs, keep pitch, loop sections. Built by GitHub Actions + fastlane on every push to main.

versions.localizedDescription: Phrases migrate to the shared SequencePlayer (P-C).
